biotools.summary: A reproducible workflow designed to process and analyze multi-year lake macrophytes and associated water quality data from the Swedish Water Framework Directive (WFD). It uses spatial random intercept models to investigate how spatial scales influence macrophyte richness and its relation to water quality.
